sn16.3:1.3: apakasseva kāyaṃ apakassa cittaṃ nicca navakā kulesu appagabbhā.
sn16.3:1.4: seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso jarudapānaṃ vā olokeyya pabbatavisamaṃ vā nadividuggaṃ vā
sn16.3:1.6: evameva kho bhikkhave candūpamā kulāni upasaṅkamatha
sn16.3:1.7: apakasseva kāyaṃ apakassa cittaṃ niccanavakā kulesu appagabbhā.
sn16.3:2.2: apakasseva kāyaṃ apakassa cittaṃ niccanavako kulesu appagabbho.
sn16.3:2.5: bhagavaṃmūlakā no bhante dhammā bhagavaṃnettikā bhagavaṃpaṭisaraṇā sādhu vata bhante bhagavantaṃyeva paṭibhātu etassa bhāsitassa attho bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantīti.
sn16.3:3.1: atha kho bhagavā ākāse pāṇiṃ cālesi
sn16.3:3.2: seyyathāpi bhikkhave ayaṃ ākāse pāṇi na sajjati na gayhati na bajjhati
sn16.3:3.3: evameva kho bhikkhave yassakassaci bhikkhuno kulāni upasaṅkamato kulesu cittaṃ na sajjati na gayhati na bajjhati
sn16.3:3.4: labhantu lābhakāmā puññakāmā karontu pana puññānīti
sn16.3:3.5: yathāsakena lābhena attamano hoti sumano evaṃ paresaṃ lābhena attamano hoti sumano.
sn16.3:3.6: evarūpo kho bhikkhave bhikkhu arahati kulāni upasaṅkamituṃ.
sn16.3:4.1: kassapassa bhikkhave kulāni upasaṅkamato kulesu cittaṃ na sajjati na gayhati na bajjhati
sn16.3:4.2: labhantu lābhakāmā puññakāmā karontu pana puññānīti
sn16.3:4.3: yathā sakena lābhena attamano hoti sumano
sn16.3:4.4: evaṃ paresaṃ lābhena attamano hoti sumano.
sn16.3:5.2: kathaṃrūpassa bhikkhuno aparisuddhā dhammadesanā hoti kathaṃrūpassa bhikkhuno parisuddhā dhammadesanā hotīti.
sn16.3:5.3: bhagavaṃmūlakā no bhante dhammā bhagavaṃnettikā bhagavaṃ paṭisaraṇā sādhu vata bhante bhagavantaṃyeva paṭibhātu etassa bhāsitassa attho bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantīti.
sn16.3:5.4: tenahi bhikkhave suṇātha sādhukaṃ manasikarotha bhāsissāmīti.
sn16.3:5.5: evaṃ bhanteti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
sn16.3:6.1: yo hi koci bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃcitto paresaṃ dhammaṃ deseti
sn16.3:6.2: aho vata me dhammaṃ suṇeyyuṃ sutvā ca pana dhammaṃ pasīdeyyuṃ pasannāva me pasannākāraṃ kareyyunti.
sn16.3:6.3: evarūpassa kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno aparisuddhā dhammadesanā hoti.
sn16.3:7.1: yo ca kho bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃcitto paresaṃ dhammaṃ deseti
sn16.3:7.2: svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo sandiṭṭhiko akāliko ehipassiko opanayiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhīti
sn16.3:7.3: aho vata me dhammaṃ suṇeyyuṃ sutvā ca pana dhammaṃ ājāneyyuṃ ājānitvā ca pana tathattāya paṭipajjeyyunti
sn16.3:7.4: iti dhammasudhammataṃ paṭicca paresaṃ dhammaṃ deseti kāruññaṃ paṭicca paresaṃ dhammaṃ deseti anudayaṃ paṭicca paresaṃ dhammaṃ deseti anukampaṃ upādāya paresaṃ dhammaṃ deseti.
sn16.3:7.5: evarūpassa kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno parisuddhā dhamma desanā hoti.
sn16.3:8.1: kassapo bhikkhave evaṃcitto paresaṃ dhammaṃ deseti
sn16.3:8.2: svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo sandiṭṭhiko akāliko ehipassiko opanayiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhīti
sn16.3:8.3: aho vata me dhammaṃ suṇeyyuṃ sutvā ca pana dhammaṃ ājāneyyuṃ ājānitvā ca pana tathattāya paṭipajjeyyunti
sn16.3:8.4: iti dhammasudhammataṃ paṭicca paresaṃ dhammaṃ deseti kāruññaṃ paṭicca paresaṃ dhammaṃ deseti anudayaṃ paṭicca paresaṃ dhammaṃ deseti anukampaṃ upādāya paresaṃ dhammaṃ deseti.
sn16.3:8.5: kassapena vā hi vo bhikkhave ovadissāmi yo vā panassa kassapādiso ovaditehi ca pana vo tathattāya paṭipajjitabbanti.
